description: This file contains an in-memory implementation of the IMembershipTable interface for testing purposes within the Orleans framework. It manages membership data for silos, including reading, updating, inserting, and cleaning up silo entries, as well as providing gateway URIs.

classes.name: InProcessMembershipTable
classes.description: An in-memory implementation of IMembershipTable and IGatewayListProvider for testing, managing silo membership data and gateway URIs.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: A private nested class within InProcessMembershipTable that manages the internal storage of membership entries, their versions, and ETags.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the membership table, currently a no-op returning a completed task.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all entries for a specified cluster ID if it matches the internal cluster ID.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific silo's membership data.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new membership entry if it does not already exist and version matches.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates an existing membership entry if the ETag and version match.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a specific membership entry.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes entries for silos that are dead and have been inactive before a specified date.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the gateway list provider, currently a no-op.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Returns a list of gateway URIs for active silos.

methods.name: GetSiloStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of a specific silo.
